note: 星光百货's architecture (task Y-mall, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-27-development-wave-3.md), drawn by src/world/mall.js. Room-local metres of the `mall` room in rooms.json (x east, z south, the entrance at z +18); its floors are that room's `levels`. void: the atrium, open through the upper floors [x0,z0,x1,z1]. escalators: scissor flights across it, each rising one floor from `level`, rising towards `rises` and moving up or down; `speed` is how fast the steps carry you (m/s along the floor). lift: the glass lift in the atrium, its door facing north onto each floor's landing. cores: solid service cores in the corners; piers: the columns along the shop fronts (z). decor: where the floor directories stand [x, z, turn, floor], the toilets door on each floor, and the span of the screens on the back wall. front: how far the shop fronts stand from the middle (east and west). units: the shops along the east (side 1) and west (side -1) walls, with the sign over each front. shops: the shop panels the counters open (title, the floor it is on, the greeting from assistants.json). directory: the floor directory's rows, top floor first. exterior: the building on 美食街 (where it stands, its size and the way it faces are its city.json `towers` entry, `drawnBy: mall`): the height of its glass front and how wide that glass is.
